_comment: Copy to ~/.config/watchtower/config.json (chmod 600 — the Jira api_token lives here). Re-read every cycle; edits need no daemon restart. One profile per client/topic context; a session arms Monitors for exactly one profile's logs.

inbox._comment: Optional: an Inbox (agent mail) events API. Watches these Inbox ids for mail arrivals (id -> label). Org-scoped or inbox-scoped API key; PASTE parks the profile. Wake lines carry ids only (the events API exposes no from/subject; the woken session lists threads and reads). auth=FAIL means SPF/DKIM/DMARC did not all pass — intake holds those for a human.

stalled._comment: Polls for the ABSENCE of change: open PRs with a standing verdict (GitHub reviewDecision APPROVED/CHANGES_REQUESTED, or a Bitbucket approval or changes-requested verdict), and Jira tickets in Review or In Progress (assigned or not), all idle for `days` days. Jira idleness follows status/assignee work-state history rather than bookkeeping updates; an Epic also includes direct-child work-state activity. Emits on entry, once per `reemit_hours` while it persists, and on clearing. Report-only; the seat decides. Repos, projects and credentials come from the blocks above. `pair_days` (default 14) is how far back merged PRs are read for `Lands-with:` trailers (the companion is a GitHub PR); a half-landed pair once found is tracked until its companion merges.

schedule._comment: Machine-local times; at-most-once per day per name, catch-up on resume. What a named wake MEANS is the session playbook's business.

globex._comment: Skeleton second profile — fill repos to activate; a source key absent means that daemon skips this profile.

watchdog._comment: Meta-watcher thresholds: a configured source whose state watermark is older than stale_minutes gets an error: line in the affected profile's watchdog log. renotify_minutes also controls standing checkout-behind/diverged and stale fetch-bound reminders; all are re-notified at most once per window.
